content:
Beyond rolling out macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple is also releasing macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8. Here are the highlights of this update.

"Important security patches"

Apple today officially launched macOS 27 Golden Gate, introducing an all-new Siri AI, along with dedicated apps, new Apple Foundation Models, and a range of improvements to Safari and Shortcuts.

In addition, Apple also rolled out macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8. The company said both updates include "important security patches" and recommended that all users install them.

Apple has not yet updated its security release page to list the specific contents of these updates. However, looking at Apple's recent track record with macOS security patches—particularly those addressing WebKit vulnerabilities—if you don't want to or can't upgrade to macOS 27, installing the updates as soon as possible would likely be a wise choice.

The build numbers for macOS Tahoe 26.7 and macOS Sequoia 15.8 are 25G229 and 24H23 respectively, matching the recent release candidates.

Notable products on Amazon

  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirTag (2nd generation) 4-pack
  • MacBook Neo
  • David Pogue — "Apple: The First 50 Years" book
  • Logitech MX Master 4
  • Wireless CarPlay adapter
